concept: Snow Family: offline transfer of large data over a thin link
tests: How to move tens of TB into AWS within a week, cheaply and practically, over slow internet.
expected: AWS Snowball Edge — a physical device; data is shipped. Triggers: "80 TB", "limited, slow internet bandwidth", "within a week".
why_not: Uploading over a slow link or via Transfer Acceleration takes too long; Direct Connect for a one-time transfer — expensive and slow to provision.
